name: WideSearch
intro: WideSearch评测大型语言模型驱动代理在广泛信息检索任务中的能力。包含200个手工筛选的问题（100英文、100中文），涵盖15个以上领域，基于真实用户查询。任务要求代理收集大量可逐条验证的原子信息，并组织成结构化输出。
org: Institute of Automation, CAS, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, ByteDance Seed, TikTok, UC
task_type: Agent任务, 开放式问答, 生成
intro_en: WideSearch evaluates the ability of large language model-driven agents in extensive information retrieval tasks. It includes 200 manually curated questions (100 in English, 100 in Chinese) across more than 15 domains, based on real user queries. The task requires agents to gather a large amount of verifiable atomic information and organize it into structured outputs.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WideSearch arXiv:2508.07999, Section 3.3 and Figure 3 for the five-stage construction pipeline. In 'Iterative Refinement and Validation,' the paper defines the 95 percent threshold as similarity between automated-evaluation and expert-human scores on the same commercial-agent response. Section 4.3 and Table 3 separately report at least 97.8 percent automated-human consistency on 200 sampled responses. Sections 3.4-3.5 and Appendix D define the 200-task bilingual composition, table parsing, primary-key alignment, hybrid cell scoring, and SR/Row-F1/Item-F1 aggregation. Official repository: https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/WideSearch.. WideSearch starts from real user queries that human annotators screen, clarify, and answer through exhaustive web search while recording completion time, search queries, keywords, and unique pages. It removes questions that a no-tool language model can answer completely, then removes tasks requiring less than ten minutes or fewer than ten unique pages. In the final validation loop, a commercial agent produces one response for each provisional task; the automated evaluator and human experts independently score that same response. If similarity between the automated and human scores is below 95 percent, the task and gold annotation are revised and the cycle repeats. Thus, 95 percent measures scorer agreement, not response-to-gold similarity. Separately, Section 4.3 evaluates 200 sampled responses and reports at least 97.8 percent automated-human consistency across judge models. The final paper set has 200 tasks, evenly split between English and Chinese across 18 topics. Evaluation parses the Markdown table and header, aligns rows by primary key, routes cells to exact, numeric, date, URL, or GPT-4.1 semantic checks, and reports perfect-table success rate plus row and item F1. Repeated runs use Avg@N, Pass@N for success rate, and Max@N for F1.
